images.after: 灯光在他们之间轻轻晃。
images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE full-bleed landscape 16:9 chapter illustration for 九域守界. Match the established illustrations: exquisite semi-realistic anime faces, naturally connected anatomy, finely painted loose hair, gold-embroidered clothing, tactile wood/stone/cloth, luminous cinematic lighting and atmospheric depth, restrained sincere emotion. References are identity and painting-style guides only, not edit targets; never copy their text, labels or collage layout. One continuous scene, no montage, panels, captions, legible lettering, watermark, logo or border. Every human has exactly two arms and hands, each clearly attached; natural fingers, physically readable interactions. Xiaoyu: adult woman, shoulder-length wavy chestnut hair, tiny gold flower pin, cream blouse with loose red necktie, BLUE cloak with intricate GOLD compass embroidery and muted red lining, brown travel trousers and boots. A palm is bandaged, one shoulder still sore; no weight suspended from the injured arm. Weikan: adult female archer, wavy brown hair, pearl earrings, deep GREEN cloak with gold botanical embroidery, cream shirt, brown travel trousers, leather bracers, ordinary bow and finite ordinary arrows. Jiang Zhaoming: adult man age25, tall slender, tousled dark-brown hair, confident composed face, sea-BLUE and WHITE fitted coat with gold embroidery, small shoulder armor, tall black boots, slender single sword with gold guard, an OLD PATCHED BRASS NAVIGATION LANTERN at his belt, its warm light modest. Lin Qingyi: youthful male angel looking thirteen, short tousled SILVER-WHITE hair, bright GOLD eyes, small slight build, cream/white traveling tunic with pale-blue/gold trim, brown belts/pouches and boots, TWO WHITE FEATHERED WINGS folded tightly behind his own back, ONE ornate hollow gold KEY-PENDANT on a chain at the chest. His companion Lewen is a SMALL BLACK-SCALED dragon with BLUE eyes, four legs, folded membranous wings, little horns and slender tail, never white. Chapter50, the warm SHARED SUPPER BEFORE departure inside a modest OLD COASTAL MATERIAL SHED with a patched roof and open side, real evening harbor beyond. The temple is ONLY TALK, not built or appearing as a hologram. ONE long old wooden table, ordinary rice/fish/soup bowls, chopsticks, steam, small shared platters. Jiang's PATCHED BRASS NAVIGATION LANTERN stands at the CENTER with an ORDINARY WICK LIGHT in the OUTER COVER, warm and modest; its deep saved tidal reservoir is NOT being spent to make a spectacle. Four main clearly detailed faces: Jiang smiling while tapping an empty table corner as if saving Xiaoyu a place to put down a heavy bag someday; Xiaoyu in blue/gold with her hands now free, laughing honestly; Weikan in green/gold beside her gently moving a hot bowl clear of her sleeve; Qingyi in white/blue and gold with silver hair and folded white wings, laughing while holding SMALL BLACK blue-eyed Lewen, which has a tiny bit of fish at its mouth. In softer depth only, Miaoyuan is the brown-haired adult man in cream clothes with a blue-gray embroidered scarf, his SMALL WHITE blue-eyed dragon Xiaobai on a DRY LOW PLATFORM beside him, not on the hot food. A honey-BLOND adult man in burgundy/gold and cream ruffled shirt can be partly visible at the near table edge, supporting his sore RIGHT ribs, amused at a harmless failed miniature ship frame made from TWO CHOPSTICKS and EMPTY BOWLS, everything stable now. Other companions are just cropped sleeves or soft silhouettes, avoid a crowded lineup of ten sharp faces. If the injured dark-haired knight appears at all, his LEFT FOREARM AND HAND are entirely IN ONE CREAM SLING across his chest, ONE free right arm, NEVER a third arm or free left hand outside the sling. The normal black cat Lili is NOT here, she stayed at Zhongwan. Salt-faded beams, night-blue water and warm lamp, people imagining shelter, benches and water while enjoying actual food. No actual god temple, deity aura, victory banner, wine drunkenness, readable lettering, giant dragons, modern canteen or magic projected architecture.
